messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "your treatment may include a special diet"
set: ["your treatment may include a special diet", "treatment may include diet", "treatment may include exercise", "treatment may include weight control", "treatment may include blood tests", "your treatment may also include diet, exercise, weight control, medical tests, and special medical care", "your treatment may also include counseling or other treatments", "your treatment may also include diet, exercise, weight control, and blood tests", "follow special diet to help prevent kidney stones", "include diet, exercise, weight control, and special medical care", "measured with a special dropper", "follow a cholesterol-lowering diet plan", "include rifampin", "use a special dose-measuring spoon or medicine cup", "this may happen especially at the beginning of your treatment", "may be only part of a complete program of treatment that also includes changes in diet or lifestyle habits"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
